summary.text: Tom Garrett is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 56th District since January 10, 2024.
The district covers the Counties of Appomattox, Buckingham and Cumberland and parts of Fluvanna, Goochland, Louisa and Prince Edward counties.
The House profile lists Tom Garrett's occupation as attorney.

paragraphs.text: Tom Garrett was born in Lilburn, Georgia.
The profile lists Louisa County High School and the University of Richmond (B.A., 1994), plus T.C. Williams Law (2003).
It lists military service as USA, January 1995 to July 2000.
The profile lists Calvary Chapel under memberships and affiliations.
Tom Garrett serves on the Education, Finance, and Communications, Technology and Innovation committees.
